rare-species.evidence: Complete detailed English community rules account for Spear’s David Bellamy Rare Species, BGG 18143, recovered unchanged within the publicly archived BGG HTML page captured 23 June 2021. The requested older archive URL redirected to that actual 2021 capture, which is recorded explicitly; this is not described as a 2010 document. The original public HTML embeds its published description as JSON in GEEK.geekitemPreload.item.description. It was decoded statically with json.JSONDecoder and the description HTML parsed as text; no JavaScript or game code was executed. The complete 3,196-character description matches the independently cached current public BGG item description exactly. It is a substantive community rules reference, not just catalogue metadata or automatically generated prose. Matching original booklet-cover and Conservation Park photographs were individually viewed; the title, David Bellamy endorsement, sex-coloured card backs and three bamboo holding spaces corroborate identity and the cage component. Account covers 2–4 players, main board/four parks/four pawns/24 cards, twelve hidden females on yellow spaces and twelve exposed males on green spaces, corner-track starts, clockwise die movement, first-stage successful female capture with male remaining on board, maximum three unpaired females in holding cages, later identification of a caged mate to claim a completed breeding pair, failed flips, stealing unpaired females from opponents and releasing one own female on a failed theft, no shared pawn spaces, skipping positions whose male was already claimed, all-females-paired ending and most completed pairs victory. Accurate source type is THIRD-PARTY COMMUNITY RULES REFERENCE HTML, not the recovered original publisher manual, a certified transcription or proof of every German/English edition. First-player selection, full-cage/occupied-space edge cases and a tiebreak are not fully specified; no missing rules were invented. The physical board, parks and complete animal-card set remain necessary. Booklet photo is only a cover, and the full original Little Red Data Book/instruction pages remain unrecovered. Selected canonical text contains only the published description, with source wording intact and HTML entities decoded; navigation, scripts and unrelated page metadata are excluded. Unchanged archived HTML and two original photos are retained with hashes. One specific MAJOR two-stage-pairing finding is recorded against the community reference, supported by the original three-cage board; no complete publisher-rulebook audit, PASS or summary-body repair.
